arguments.value: Ask the user to set the preferred display order in Windows Display settings: identify the monitor they want as primary, click it, then check “Make this my main display.” If needed, disconnect the motherboard VGA display, since onboard video and discrete GPU outputs can change which screen becomes primary when using “PC screen only.”
